bagPolicy.summary: Supporters are strongly urged not to bring bags. If necessary, bags must be no larger than A4 size (21cm x 30cm).
allowed: Bags no larger than A4 size (21cm x 30cm)
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medical or childcare requirements, which will be searched and tagged at dedicated lanes.

parking.note: Public transport is strongly recommended on event days because road closures and parking restrictions vary. Review Scottish Rugby's current matchday travel information before setting out.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Scottish Gas Murrayfield's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and drink outlets operate around the stadium and fan areas. Scottish Gas Murrayfield is cashless; vendor selection and opening points vary by event.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Scottish Gas Murrayfield, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Scottish Gas Murrayfield's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
